'''Yerem''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the final decades of the Republic's rule.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Yerem was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Master Yerem was appointed as an [[Jedi academy|academy]] [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Yerem taught beginning courses of the [[Force power/Legends|technique]] of [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitation]], and one of his students was [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]]. Pavan recalled Yerem's lessons while attempting to survive during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|dangerous times]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the [[18 BBY/Legends|year after]] the Order was [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|dissolved]].<ref name="CNII" />
